newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia congratulates Britain's Blair on victory.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia congratulates Britain's Blair on victory.

text.p: Malaysia said on Friday it looked forward to continuing its "excellent relations" with Britain and congratulated Labour Party leader Tony Blair on his election victory.

"I think we welcome the decision of the British public, congratulate Tony Blair as the new prime minister and believe we will continue the excellent relations between Britain and Malaysia," Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told reporters.
"I believe that the prime minister (Mahathir Mohamad) will certainly look forward to an early meeting with Prime Minister Tony Blair," Anwar added.
Mahathir is scheduled to visit Britain on May 20 to promote Malaysia's planned zone for information technology, the Multimedia Super Corridor.
Malaysia's ties with Britain went through a rocky patch under John Major, whose Conservative party was buried under a Labour landslide in Thursday's election.
Mahathir's government imposed a seven-month ban in 1994 on government contracts for British firms over allegations in the media and parliament that Anglo-Malaysia trade was tainted by corruption.
